messages:
jia_wu: Quick share — ran a cross-region perf sweep for llama3-xl (onboard/quant experiments). H100 vs A100, fp16 vs int8. EU p95 is higher than expected, can folks eyeball?
infra-bot: benchmark job 2412345678 started (configs: model=llama3-xl, batch=1, seq=1024, warmup=50).
sam_cartwright: paste the raw numbers if you have them (p50/p95 + rps).
jia_wu: sure, raw CSV from the run: 
```
region,gpu,quant,p50_ms,p95_ms,rps
us-east,h100,fp16,27,110,420
us-east,h100,int8,24,95,480
us-west,a100,int8,46,220,260
eu-west,h100,int8,38,180,310
eu-west,a100,int8,52,240,230
```
note: all runs used default kernel selection (auto), no prefix cache.
martin_k: interesting — us-west A100 tail (p95 220ms) looks dominated by network + edge mux. I see ~35ms extra hop in traces for ~40% of requests, probably TLS session churn at the edge.
eva_garcia: also seeing EU warmup behaviour in traces — cold KV-cache hits ~12% of requests during the run -> that explains the eu-west p95 bump on H100 int8. Enabling prefix_cache should cut those tails.
sam_cartwright: can we isolate kernel impact? try flash-attn vs fused kernels on H100 and A100, and run with prefix_cache=true. Something like:
```
./bench_runner --model llama3-xl --gpu h100 --quant int8 --kernel flash --prefix_cache true --region eu-west
./bench_runner --model llama3-xl --gpu a100 --quant int8 --kernel fused --prefix_cache true --region us-west
```
infra-bot: job 2412345678 completed. logs: s3://redwood-bench/2412345678/logs (raw latencies + traces).
deploy-bot: FYI — canary route flip ready for us-west direct path (no mux) if eng-ml approves.
nora_qa: ran a quick quality sweep on the int8 artifacts from these runs — mean ROUGE delta vs fp16 is 0.6 (small; looked fine on 200 prompts). No obvious hallucination regressions.
jia_wu: summary / action items: 1) enable prefix_cache in eu-west (senior ML infra) 2) flip us-west canary to direct path for a 30m test (deploy team) 3) run kernel matrix (flash vs fused vs auto) with warmup=200 and collect p50/p95 + cold-hit fraction (eng-ml) 4) re-check A100 quant profile + throughput tuning (quant team).
sam_cartwright: +1, I can run the kernel matrix once deploy flips the route.
eva_garcia: I'll instrument KV cold-hit metric and add a short alert if >5% during canary.
martin_k: will follow up with trace snippets — looks like edge TLS session cache is the weakest link, we can mitigate with session reuse.
jia_wu: thanks all — posting a short doc with links to logs and commands (will add to the bench board). :sparkles:
